findings.title: Timed-out batches are reported as acknowledged and never retried
findings.trigger: send_batch raises BrokerTimeout for any batch.
findings.impact: The except block only logs and falls through to acknowledged.extend, so relay_once marks every row in the failed batch published. Those events leave the outbox without reaching the broker, which breaks the at-least-once promise in outbox.py. Before this change a timeout propagated and the rows stayed pending; the except block needs a continue.
